summary.text: Schuyler VanValkenburg is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 16, serving since 2024.
The district covers part of Henrico County.
Schuyler VanValkenburg served in the House from 2018 to 2024, and the Senate biography lists Schuyler VanValkenburg's occupation as teacher.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Schuyler VanValkenburg was born in Charlotte, North Carolina.
It lists a B.A. in History from the University of Richmond (2004) and an M.A. in History from Virginia Commonwealth University (2008).
Schuyler VanValkenburg serves on the Rehabilitation and Social Services Committee (as chair), Education and Health, General Laws and Technology, Local Government, and Rules.
